s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic gastrointestinal symptoms with malabsorption and dermatological manifestations
salient_findings: Brownish macules on the hands and feet
Hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk
key_facts: Multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
Nodular lymphoid lesions in the duodenum
Numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum
History of cleft lip and palate repair

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic gastrointestinal symptoms with malabsorption and dermatological manifestations
salient_findings: Brownish macules on the hands and feet
Hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk
key_facts: Multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
Nodular lymphoid lesions in the duodenum
Numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum
History of cleft lip and palate repair

shortlist.label: Cronkhite-Canada syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the combination of gastrointestinal symptoms, malabsorption, and dermatological manifestations, including the presence of multiple polyps and characteristic skin lesions

shortlist.label: Juvenile polyposis syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Explains the recurrent diarrheal episodes and presence of numerous polyps throughout the colon and rectum, although the skin lesions are not typical

shortlist.label: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Could account for the gastrointestinal symptoms and polyps, but the absence of characteristic mucocutaneous melanin deposits makes it less likely

shortlist.label: Familial adenomatous polyposis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible explanation for the multiple polyps, but the presence of atrophic gastric mucosa and nodular lymphoid lesions is not typical

shortlist.label: Acrodermatitis enteropathica
shortlist.why_kept: Could explain the dermatological manifestations and some gastrointestinal symptoms, but the presence of multiple polyps is not characteristic

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of watery diarrhea, vomiting, diffuse abdominal pain, weight loss, and characteristic skin and nail changes (brownish macules, hyperchromic punctate lesions, and onychodystrophy) along with the presence of multiple gastrointestinal polyps and atrophic gastric mucosa are consistent with Cronkhite-Canada syndrome.

rejected.label: Juvenile polyposis syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic skin and nail changes and specific polyp distribution

rejected.label: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
rejected.why: Absence of characteristic mucocutaneous melanin deposits and specific polyp type

rejected.label: Familial adenomatous polyposis
rejected.why: Typically presents with hundreds to thousands of adenomatous polyps, not seen in this case

rejected.label: Acrodermatitis enteropathica
rejected.why: Primarily associated with zinc deficiency and skin lesions, but does not account for the gastrointestinal polyps and other findings
